sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: A student adds 9 and 4 before multiplying when evaluating 9 + (4 × 6). Identify and correct the error.

steps: Name the error: the student ignored the grouped multiplication.
Then add 9: 9 + 24 = 33, which corrects both the reasoning and result.
workedSolution.answer: The student added before multiplying; 4 × 6 should be evaluated first, giving 33.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A student says, “In 715571, the value of the 5 in the hundreds place is 10 times as much as the value of the 5 in the thousands place.” Which statement best analyzes the error?
choices: Both digits have value 5; repeated digits always have the same value.
The values are 500 and 5000; 500 is 10 times as much as 5000.
The values are 500 and 5000; 500 is 1/10 as much as 5000, so the student's comparison is incorrect.
The places are adjacent, so 500 is 100 times as much as 5000.

items.prompt: Which expression means: “Subtract 7 from 13, multiply the difference by 7, then add 45.”
Which phrase describes 39 + [5 × (23 - 8)] without evaluating it?
choices: Subtract 8 from 23, multiply the difference by 5, then add 39.
Subtract 8 from 23, add 5, then multiply the sum by 39.
Add 23 and 8, multiply the sum by 5, then add 39.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Let E represent 3964 + 381. Without evaluating, how does (3964 + 381) + 662 compare with E?
A supply cart has 54 boxes with 27 markers in each box and 22 loose markers. Which expression represents the total number of markers?
A team packs 59 crates with 65 bottles in each crate, adds 76 loose bottles, and then uses 52 bottles. How many bottles remain?
In 3331827, how does the value of the 3 in the ten-thousands place compare with the value of the 3 in the hundred-thousands place?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate 92500 + 273500.
Round 350 to the nearest hundred and 85 to the nearest ten, then multiply to estimate the product.
